chapter_title: Concerning the Ten Things that the Ambassador bega
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2.
** First
: The Divine
 Ordering Principle proceeded
 from the
 Infinite
 to establish
 a
 new state
 of the church —
 a new interior
 heaven within
 the mind
,
 formed
 according
 to celest
ial order
.

**¶3.**
 Second: The systems
 of doctrine
,
 which
 are
 vessels carrying
 tru
ths, advanced
 through the interior
 celestial degrees of
 understanding
 toward
 the in
most heav
ens of
 the mind.

**¶4
.** Third: The cycles
 of Divine
 Providence began
 to communicate
 the influx of good and truth simultaneously
 into
 the natural mind and
 into
 the interior
 spiritual and
 celestial degrees,
 so
 that all
 planes
 of the
 mind might receive
 life
 from
 the Divine.

**¶5
.** *
[
Lost.
]*

**¶6.**
 Fifth
: The open
ings of the doctrinal vessels
 —
 the means
 by which truths contained within
 systems
 of understanding
 become communicable —
 were made
 accessible,
 so that the infl
ux of wisdom
 could
 pass
 freely
 between
 degrees
.


**¶7.**
 Sixth: Other
 open
ings were also established
,
 but
 these
 were made
 recept
ive for
 the purpose
 of separation
 —
 so
 that fals
ities and evils could be drawn
 out and removed, as
 waste
 is
 expelled
 from what
 is living
.

**¶8.**
 Seventh: The prop
rium —
 the self
-derived evil
 of
 the
 will
 — was distinguished
 and extracted from the dominant false persu
asions that had
 governed the corrupted understanding
.
 This
 was
 accomplished
 through
 the mediating operation of Divine
 Truth
 proce
eding from Divine Good.
 Once
 separated, this
 evil precip
itated into the natural mind, where it
 became
 manifest and could at
 last be confronted and
 res
isted.

**¶9.
**
 Eighth: States
 of spiritual obscurity were
 distinguished from states
 of spiritual clarity —
 fals
ity was
 perceived
 as fals
ity, and truth as truth —
 so that the understanding
 could
 disc
ern between
 them,
 as
 the first
 act
 of all
 regener
ation requires
.

**¶10.**
 Ninth:
 Incomplete
 spiritual formations —
 goods and truths that had
 been
 conceived inter
iorly but could not be
 carried
 to full birth
 — fell
 to the lowest
 sensory plane
, where
 they became merely corpor
eal and
 without
 spiritual life
.
 These
 are
 per
ceptions begun
 but never
 brought
 to fru
ition,
 aff
ections stir
red but never completed
.

**¶11.**
 Tenth: Successive changes of state
 began
 to take
 place throughout
 the intermediate
 spiritual
 sphere —
 the passage
 of affections and
 thoughts through varying
 degrees and forms,
 as
 the mind underg
oes its reformation
.
 This
 is
 the continuous
 re
-ordering
 of interior
 life
 by
 which
 what
 belongs
 to the prop
rium is gradually
 displaced
 by
 what flows
 in
 from the Divine,
 through
 states
 that
 appear
 as one
 form
 of
 life
 passing
 into
 another.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
The sixth is the doors too [of the ships, the lower ones;] [the gates set for separation,] that they were opened to receive the waste.
The seventh is [the Sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.

The fifth is the doors
 of the ships, that they were opened
 up [to send forth the refined light
 to the aeons on high.]

The eighth: Night and day were separated
 [so that the light was distinguished from
 the darkness.]
